mapper.select: SELECT company_code, review_master_code, review_master_name, review_start_date, review_end_date, use_yn, remark FROM tb_hr_review_master ORDER BY review_start_date desc
SELECT company_code, review_master_code, review_master_name, review_start_date, review_end_date, use_yn, remark FROM tb_hr_review_master WHERE review_master_code = #{rmCode}
SELECT eval_seq, company_code, review_master_code, eval_name, eval_detail, eval_weight FROM tb_eval_item WHERE review_master_code = #{rmCode}

SELECT company_code, review_master_code, review_master_name, review_start_date, review_end_date, use_yn, remark FROM tb_hr_review_master
AND review_master_name LIKE '%' || #{reviewMasterName} || '%'
AND review_start_date BETWEEN TRUNC(#{reviewStartDate}) AND TRUNC(#{reviewEndDate})
AND use_yn IN
#{yn}
ORDER BY review_start_date desc
mapper.insert:
SELECT fn_make_date_code('REVIEW_MASTER') FROM dual
INSERT INTO tb_hr_review_master ( company_code, review_master_code, review_master_name, review_start_date, review_end_date, use_yn, remark, created_by, create_date) VALUES ( #{companyCode}, #{reviewMasterCode}, #{reviewMasterName}, #{reviewStartDate}, #{reviewEndDate}, #{useYn}, #{remark}, #{createdBy}, SYSDATE)

SELECT eval_seq.nextval FROM dual
INSERT INTO tb_eval_item ( eval_seq, company_code, review_master_code, eval_name, eval_detail, eval_weight, created_by, create_date) VALUES ( #{evalSeq}, #{companyCode}, #{reviewMasterCode}, #{evalName}, #{evalDetail}, #{evalWeight}, #{createdBy}, SYSDATE)
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_hr_review_master SET review_master_name = #{reviewMasterName}, review_start_date = #{reviewStartDate}, review_end_date = #{reviewEndDate}, use_yn = #{useYn}, remark = #{remark}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, update_date = #{updateDate} WHERE review_master_code = #{reviewMasterCode}
